newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU racism observatory to be based in Vienna.
newsitem.headline: EU racism observatory to be based in Vienna.

text.p: The European Union's new observatory on racism and xenophobia will be based in Vienna, the bloc's foreign ministers agreed on Monday.

The goal of the observatory will be to collect and analyse reliable and objective information and carry out scientific research and studies to find ways of fighting racism, xenophobia and anti-semitism in the EU.
It will collect information in areas like free movement of people throughout the 15-nation bloc, culture and the media, employment and education.
